feeds.title: Siciliani Creativi
feeds.description: Siciliani Creativi is your place to find the ultimate guides for Sicilian recipes related to sweets, pasta, and much more. The site Sicilians creative in the kitchen was conceived and managed entirely by Ada Parisi and Gianluca Atzeni, both professional journalists. This Blog page contains infallible recipes, video tutorials, travel itineraries, and insights made in Italy by the blogger Ada.

feeds.title: Romeing » Restaurants in Rome
feeds.description: Romeing is an English magazine for tourists and expats visiting or living in Rome. Rome's English guide for tourists & expats to events, exhibitions, restaurants, bars, shopping, attractions, music, clubs, nightlife, tours & experiences.

feeds.title: Katie Parla Blog
feeds.description: Italian-American food expert, journalist, and culinary guide Katie Parla's Italian Food blog. The mission of the blog is to get people talking about what they are eating and why they are eating it focusing specially on Italian food culture, and critical reviews of restaurants and trends.

feeds.title: Elizabeth Minchilli
feeds.description: Elizabeth Minchilli is a Rome-based writer and has been reporting on all sorts of good stuff from this city for the last 20 years. She has been contributing to most of the big travel and lifestyle magazines during that time and has written nine books.

feeds.title: An American in Rome Blog
feeds.description: An American in Rome is your essential guide to Rome, Italy, and beyond - from someone who actually lives here. You will find hundreds of personally vetted recommendations for what to do in Rome, where to eat, how to get around, and what you shouldn't waste your time or money on.
